aboutTitle: Building the future, one line at a time
aboutText: I'm a developer passionate about crafting accessible, pixel-perfect user interfaces that blend thoughtful design with robust engineering. My favorite work lies at the intersection of design and development.

I recently graduated with a degree in Computer Science and I'm eager to join a team where I can contribute, learn, and grow. I'm particularly interested in frontend development, but I enjoy exploring the full stack.
When I'm not coding, you'll find me contributing to open source, reading about new technologies, or working on side projects to sharpen my skills.
contactBio: If you're interested in working together feel free to reach out.
